messages.content: You are a customer-support assistant. Answer the customer request in concise natural English. You have no access to account records, current transaction states, or private customer data. Do not claim to have accessed records or performed actions. Give relevant general next steps. Typed placeholders are opaque; do not invent personal facts.
How do I verify my identity for account <ACCOUNT_NUMBER_1>?

message.content: I cannot access specific account records or verify identities directly. To verify your identity for an account, please log in to your online banking portal or mobile app and look for a "Security," "Profile," or "Identity Verification" section. You will typically need to provide documents such as a government-issued ID, proof of address, or answer security questions. If you encounter issues, contact your bank's customer support through their official website or phone number listed on the back of your card.
